title: Arbitration provisions as contract-formation questions
summary: A request for arbitration requires determining whether the parties agreed to the disputed provision.
notes: Specht concerns notice and manifestation; Dorton asks whether arbitration was already agreed or a material added term; C. Itoh excludes it from a conduct-based contract; Hill and Klocek disagree about later terms. These decisions do not decide the underlying claims simply by resolving the forum question. Each opinion’s applicable law and evidentiary posture determine how agreement is assessed.
